home.heroSubtitle: Real-time statutory procurement intelligence platform aggregating unfilled in-progress tenders, complete Standard Bidding Documents (SBD / RFP), 17-year awarded bid records (2010 – 2026), and contractor intelligence from 28+ official Central and State government portals — powered by an Enterprise Hybrid Persistent Database Architecture.

capabilities.title: What Our Application Does
capabilities.subtitle: Engineered specifically for infrastructure contractors, EPC estimators, pre-bid analysts, and government procurement officers.
capabilities.pillar1Title: 1. Live In-Progress Tender Discovery & Document Viewer
capabilities.pillar1Desc: Direct statutory scraping of active, unfilled notices across 28+ Central and State procurement portals. Inspect comprehensive tender details without registering on individual state portals.
capabilities.pillar1Point1: Full Standard Bidding Document (SBD / RFP): In-app interactive viewer & 1-click PDF download.
capabilities.pillar1Point2: Volume I–IV Specifications: Instructions to Bidders, GCC, Technical Specs & BOQ Rate Schedules.
capabilities.pillar1Point3: Statutory Pre-Qualification (PQC): Automated 3-2-1 similar work rules, turnover, and net worth checks.
capabilities.pillar1Point4: GFR Rule 170 / MSME Exemptions: Real-time assessment of EMD waivers and technical exemptions.
capabilities.pillar2Title: 2. 17-Year Awarded Bids & Letters of Acceptance (LOA) Archive
capabilities.pillar2Desc: Explore how leading contractors (L&T, Tata Projects, Afcons, Dilip Buildcon, NCC, B.G. Shirke) structured winning bids, technical submissions, and secured official government work orders.
capabilities.pillar2Point1: 4,350+ Historical Awarded Dossiers: Covering awarded contracts from 2010 to 2026 across India.
capabilities.pillar2Point2: Winning Price vs Estimate Rebate: Exact percentage variance (% below or above estimated cost).
capabilities.pillar2Point3: 3-Cover Submission Structure: Fee/EMD Cover, Technical Experience Cover, and Financial Price Bid.
capabilities.pillar2Point4: Official LOA Orders: Work orders with bank guarantee mandates and milestone delivery schedules.
capabilities.pillar3Desc: Search corporate profiles of registered Indian infrastructure contractors, audited annual turnovers, working capital, banker solvency limits, and complete awarded contract books.
capabilities.pillar3Point1: Class-I & Super Class Classifications: Official statutory registration levels across CPWD, NHAI, Railways, and State PWDs.
capabilities.pillar3Point2: Financial Capability Metrics: 3-year average turnover, peak turnover, and net worth analysis.
capabilities.pillar3Point3: Awarded Contract Portfolios: Complete history of government contracts won till date.
capabilities.pillar3Point4: Competitor Analysis: Benchmark competitor bids before submitting financial proposals.
capabilities.pillar4Title: 4. Enterprise Hybrid Database & Statutory Scraper Engine
capabilities.pillar4Desc: Built with an Enterprise Hybrid Persistent Database Architecture (PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector or SQLite) alongside high-speed in-memory RAM streaming for instant sub-millisecond filtering.
capabilities.pillar4Point1: Automated 4:00 AM IST Cron: Daily scheduled synchronization ingesting fresh procurement notices.
capabilities.pillar4Point2: On-Demand Manual Sync: Instant synchronization across all 28+ government portals.
capabilities.pillar4Point3: Strict Portal Binding: Ensures state-specific portals strictly map to their geographic locations.
capabilities.pillar4Point4: Vector & Semantic Ready: Ready for deep LLM retrieval augmented generation (RAG) across tender clauses.

prediction.desc: Synthesized using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) against 2,600+ historical awarded tenders. Evaluates mandatory PQC turnover/solvency thresholds, authority Schedule of Rates (SOR) clearance margins, and regional contractor proximity to project likely competitor bids before you submit.

msme.title: Statutory MSE Exemption Advisory (Rule 170 of GFR 2017)
msme.subtitle: Legal provisions under Government of India Public Procurement Policy for MSEs Order 2012.
msme.guaranteed: 100% EMD Exemption Guaranteed for UDYAM MSEs
msme.desc: Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) registered with UDYAM Registration portal are completely exempt from furnishing Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) under Rule 170 of General Financial Rules (GFR) 2017.
msme.checklistTitle: Checklist to Claim Exemption in Cover-1:
msme.check1: Valid UDYAM Registration Certificate with matching National Industry Classification (NIC) codes
msme.check2: Bid Security Declaration (Form B) in lieu of EMD on bidder letterhead
msme.check3: Class-I / Class-II Local Supplier Self-Declaration under Public Procurement (Make in India) Order

portalBridge.title: Official Portal Direct Bridge
portalBridge.canSearchPrePopulated: Can search fields be pre-populated for all sources?
portalBridge.yesForGem: ✅ Yes for GeM: Government e-Marketplace supports URL-based search parameters with zero captcha on public searches. Clicking the gateway button below will open GeM with this Tender ID pre-filled!
portalBridge.notNativelyOnGepnic: ⚠️ Not natively via web links on GePNIC / State Portals: National NIC portals (CPPP, MahaTenders, defproc, etc.) run Apache Tapestry with server-side session states that deliberately ignore URL query parameters and mandate entering a human visual captcha. Furthermore, modern browsers enforce strict Same-Origin Policy preventing external web apps from script-injecting into government domains.
portalBridge.twoSecondWorkflowDesc: The Tender ID is already copied! Click gateway → Paste (Ctrl+V / Cmd+V) into Tender ID / Ref No → Type Captcha → Search.
portalBridge.wantOneClick: Want 1-click auto-fill? Use the "Auto-Fill & Focus Captcha" Bookmarklet
portalBridge.bookmarkletDesc: Since browsers block cross-site script injection, a Bookmarklet runs locally in your browser with full access to the portal page. It reads your copied Tender ID, types it into the search box, and puts your cursor right inside the Captcha box!
portalBridge.saveBookmark: Save as a browser bookmark & click it on the portal.
